title: Validity of Physical Activity Questionnaires in Persons Pursuing Bariatric Surgery
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the validity of the Human Activity Profile and Godin self-report questionnaires of physical activity in persons seeking metabolic surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \>19
* BMI \> 30
* Able to speak and understand English
* Consent to provide access to medical records for medical history
* Will receive weight loss procedure (sleeve gastrectomy or gastric bypass) at Nebraska Medicine
* Consent to wear an activity tracker device for 7 days after designated visits.

Exclusion Criteria:

• Age \< 19
study_population: Patients seeking bariatric surgery at University of Nebraska Medical Center/Nebraska Medicine
